environment.description: Spring Boot 3.2 application deployed on ECS Fargate with 4 replicas behind an ALB. Database is Amazon RDS PostgreSQL 15.4 with default configuration. Connection pooling via HikariCP (pool_size=20 per instance). The @Transactional annotation uses default READ_COMMITTED isolation. No database-level advisory locks or SELECT FOR UPDATE. Standard pgBouncer 1.21 in transaction pooling mode sits between the app and RDS with default settings (server_reset_query = DISCARD ALL).
